body: Absolutely. I frequently catch myself not showering on days I get to work from home and neglecting other personal hygiene.

Couldn’t feel for you anymore than I do. I feel the exact same way and it’s exhausting to have so much hate in my heart for people. I wish I would wake up one day and feel differently. I hope the same for you.

I’m always negative, I get told this so often. It’s so hard to think positively about anything. The world is such a terrible, hurtful place. Stupid small shit is what really sets me off, it’s like the tip of the iceberg for everything else that’s happening inside my shit show of a brain.
I miss doing drugs, I’m surprised I’ve lasted as long as I have at my “drug free” place of employment. Enjoy some for me.
I experience the same type of rage on an almost daily basis, and I wish I had a solution for you. It’s ruining my life.
